clue.text: The main part of the vehicle must reverse before making ascent

indicators.note: the vehicle has to go into reverse, so its word is read from back to front

parts.note: a bus is a road vehicle

indicators.note: the letters of ascent are made into a new word, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver is told to back the bus up before it can climb a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must reverse' turns BUS into SUB; 'making' rearranges ASCENT into STANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: The substance of something is its core or essence, the chief part.

clue.text: Ill-informed-under a misapprehension

indicators.note: a misapprehension is a muddled grasp of things, so the letters are muddled too

explanation.surface: Someone poorly briefed is labouring under a false belief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misapprehension' rearranges UNDER plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is unread has not studied books, so is lacking knowledge.

clue.text: A saw to give voice about always

indicators.note: the singing word goes around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: to give voice can mean to sing
ay (also aye) is an old word for always

explanation.surface: A carpentry saw is being used as an excuse to start singing.
explanation.walkthrough: AY for 'always' is old or poetic, as in 'for ay'. 'saw' is not the tool but a proverb.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old proverb or maxim, a familiar piece of wisdom.

clue.text: Takes up unusual post after seeing commercial

indicators.note: the rearranged word comes after the commercial in the answer

parts.note: an ad is a commercial advertisement

indicators.note: in an unusual form, so the letters of post are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes an odd job after spotting it advertised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges POST into OPTS, placed after AD.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt a cause or child is to take it up as one's own.

clue.text: Commiserate with many over the unemployment allowance

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
on can mean over, as in resting on top of
the dole is British slang for state unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: Someone sympathises with the many people living on benefits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word. 'the dole' is the British everyday name for unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: To condole is to express sympathy with someone in grief or trouble.

clue.text: Newsmen respecting railway workers

parts.note: re means with regard to, respecting
porters carry luggage at railway stations

explanation.surface: Journalists are covering a story about station staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Reporters are journalists who gather and write the news.

clue.text: Tom's in bed-may be made to get up

indicators.note: the words can be made into something else, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: the apostrophe-s here is 'Tom is', so its S counts as a letter

explanation.surface: Tom is still lying in bed and may need to be forced up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be made' rearranges TOMS IN BED. 'get up' is used transitively: to raise someone from a tomb.
explanation.definitionFit: To disentomb is to take a body out of a grave, raising it from burial.

clue.text: There's depression about the French soil check

indicators.note: the depression word wraps around the French word, enclosing it

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression
terre is French for earth or soil

explanation.surface: A gloomy remark about the soil of France being inspected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'There's' is a link. 'depression' looks like gloom; it is a hollow, DENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A deterrent is something that checks or discourages an action.

clue.text: A refreshing way to study

parts.note: going over notes again to refresh memory before an exam, a fresh look at the material

explanation.definitionFit: Students go back over their material to refresh it before exams.

clue.text: A dog of the hare!

parts.note: a hound bred to chase hares in coursing, and the hare's colour is grey

explanation.definitionFit: This breed of racing dog is used for hare coursing.

clue.text: Unite to get business in this place

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a business
here means in this place

explanation.surface: Firms are urged to combine locally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to stick together or form a unified whole.

clue.text: It's crazy turning on people for malediction

indicators.note: the reversed piece goes on, in front of, the next piece
the word for crazy is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: mad means crazy
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Madness that turns on a whole population is a curse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses MAD to DAM. 'It's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A malediction is a curse; damnation is condemnation, used as a curse.

clue.text: Ancient coin held in trust-a terrible responsibility

indicators.note: the answer is held inside the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A trust carries an awful burden.
explanation.walkthrough: The run truST A TERrible holds the coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The stater was a gold or silver coin of ancient Greece.

clue.text: The musicians' game?

parts.note: a word naming both a light piece of music and a table game with balls and pins

explanation.definitionFit: A bagatelle is a short light piano piece and also a pub table game.

clue.text: Alter the siting of the stove at the back

parts.note: rear means at the back
a range is a large cooking stove

explanation.surface: Someone wants to move the cooker that sits at the back of the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To rearrange is to change the order or position of things.

clue.text: Revelled in rise to assembly when in the red

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed inside the colour word

parts.note: taken as the colour word itself

indicators.note: assembly means putting parts together, so the letters of rise to are put together afresh

explanation.surface: A party-goer celebrates a promotion even while overdrawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' rearranges RISE TO into OISTER, which goes 'in' RED. The first 'in' and 'when the' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To roister is to celebrate noisily, to make merry.

clue.text: Animal end-product, for example

indicators.note: the end of the word product means its final letter

explanation.surface: Livestock feed is the end product of farming, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: A TEG is a farming word for a sheep in its second year.
explanation.definitionFit: A teg is a young sheep, a farm animal, in its second year.

clue.text: Drink some hot chocolate at bed-time

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the following words are used, in sequence

explanation.surface: A child has a cup of hot chocolate before bed.
explanation.walkthrough: chocolaTE At hides the drink. 'hot' is part of the surface only.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is a hot drink made from infused leaves.

clue.text: Travel requires a casual sort of shirt, that's understood

parts.note: to go is to travel
a T-shirt is a casual shirt

explanation.surface: Packing for a trip means bringing a T-shirt, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'requires' and 'that's' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Got means grasped or understood, as in 'I got it'.

clue.text: New name one's giving a plant

indicators.note: the words are given a new form, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: here the apostrophe-s is 'one is', a link, so only ONE gives letters

explanation.surface: A botanist renames a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges NAME and ONE. 'giving' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The anemone is a flowering plant of the buttercup family.

clue.text: Sporting individuals involved in a row

definitions.text: Sporting individuals involved in a row

parts.words: Sporting individuals involved in a row
parts.note: a row sounds like a quarrel, but here it is rowing a boat

explanation.definitionFit: Members of a rowing crew pull the oars in a race.

clue.text: The skill of the well-organised tar

indicators.note: the letters are organised into a new order

explanation.surface: A tidy sailor has a particular talent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tar' is a sailor in the surface, but here just three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Art can mean a craft or skill, as in the art of conversation.

clue.text: Leaves military personnel on fatigues

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
to fatigue someone is to tire them, so fatigues gives tires

explanation.surface: Soldiers on leave wear their army fatigues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fatigues' looks like army clothing but is a verb. 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire is to leave, withdraw or go away.

clue.text: Stop, having a right to a break

parts.note: a rest is a break

explanation.surface: Someone stops work, claiming a right to a breather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' and 'to a' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrest is to halt or check something.

clue.text: Put in a good word for quiet lift

definitions.text: Put in a good word for

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
to raise is to lift

explanation.surface: Someone discreetly recommends a colleague for a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: To praise someone is to speak well of them, commending them.

clue.text: Shoot at duck to be eaten

parts.note: to pot is to shoot game
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A hunter shoots at a duck intending to cook it.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a duck is a score of zero, hence O.
explanation.definitionFit: The potato is a staple vegetable, something grown for food.

clue.text: Found and copied

definitions.meaning: drawn over the lines of an original seen through thin paper

explanation.definitionFit: Traced means located after searching, and also reproduced a drawing by going over it.

clue.text: Not left in the main

parts.note: the main is the sea, and the side of a ship that is not left is the right side

explanation.definitionFit: Starboard is the right-hand side of a vessel, facing forward.

clue.text: He escapes a woman, the German male!

parts.note: Eva is a woman's name
der is the German masculine form of the

explanation.surface: A man flees from a woman and a German fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'male' points to the masculine German article for 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: An evader is someone who escapes or dodges something.

clue.text: The regulation of Israeli capital invested in munitions

indicators.note: to be invested in is to be put inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: ordnance means military supplies and munitions

indicators.note: a capital letter is the first letter, so take the start of Israeli

explanation.surface: Israel's capital spending on arms is governed by rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like Jerusalem but gives I, the first letter of Israeli.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinance is an authoritative order or rule.

clue.text: The youth carrying food back was in no hurry

indicators.note: the youth word carries the other piece within it

parts.note: a lad is a youth

indicators.note: the word is read back to front

parts.note: an egg is food

explanation.surface: A boy dawdles home with the shopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns EGG into GGE, which LAD carries.
explanation.definitionFit: To lag is to fall behind or go slowly.

clue.text: Space-travellers needing specially-designed radio-sets

indicators.note: the letters are freshly designed into a new order

explanation.surface: Astronauts need custom radios.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Space-travellers' suggests astronauts; here they are rocks orbiting the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Asteroids are small rocky bodies moving through space around the sun.
